Data.description: Three-panel visualization map (PNG, 24x8 inches, 150 DPI). Panel 1: aspect > 100° condition (YlOrRd), Panel 2: within 1000m of roads condition (Blues), Panel 3: combined camping suitability overlaid on terrain DEM (Greens on terrain). Includes legend and coordinate axes in WGS 84.

Binary suitability raster (GeoTIFF, EPSG:4326, LZW-compressed, uint8). Values: 1 = suitable for camping (aspect > 100° AND within 1000m of a road), 0 = unsuitable or nodata. 6,998 x 3,354 pixels at ~0.000833° resolution covering Pennsylvania. ~8.3M suitable pixels (~53,773 km²).
